approval: User explicitly approved Google traffic-aware + ORS control and aggregate-only Google retention in this chat before this protocol was recorded.
current_rq: How do Google traffic-aware travel-time estimates differ from ORS control estimates on fixed Astana routes during peak and off-peak periods?
hypothesis: Peak-window median absolute Google-ORS disagreement will exceed off-peak-window median absolute disagreement. The earlier 1.5 ratio is retained as a prospective descriptive reference, not a revised original ER.
analysis: Compare published per-window aggregate metrics descriptively, retaining dates and sample counts. Do not treat 100 requests as independent samples or run the original route-by-day Wilcoxon without route-level Google evidence.
storage: No individual Google route times, distances or geometry retained. Publish own aggregate benchmark statistics, request status/timestamps, permitted ORS evidence, code and complete request protocol.
limitations: Google with traffic versus ORS without live traffic conflates providers and models. This cannot isolate a causal traffic effect or measure accuracy. Google numeric aggregates cannot be independently recalculated from saved Google raw outputs; repeating the protocol observes new live values.
execution: One prospective batch per window, at its first eligible worker check. Record actual times; never backfill a missed window. Skip or stop when outside the window/end, budget exhausted or credential/rate limit occurs. Google-specific failures stop further Google follow-ups while permitted ORS collection continues.
supersedes_for_new_traffic_comparison: The initial TomTom-2GIS comparison remains unperformed. This is an explicitly dated Google-ORS control design, not relabelled earlier data.
representation_amendment: Before the first follow-up window, route hashing was normalized for Windows/Linux line endings; coordinates, windows and scientific expectations unchanged.
